device.category: semi-modular analogue percussion synthesizer with 8-step sequencer, desktop or 60HP Eurorack
device.based_on: Original Moog design (2017), part of the Mother-32 family; recreated by the Behringer EDGE (modelled separately).

sources.title: Moog DFAM Owner's Manual (2017)
sources.note: Signal flow, guided exploration with clock positions, every control with typical settings, patchbay levels and normals, sync with DFAM/Mother-32, Eurorack install, ten preset patch sheets (cables legible, knobs drawn) and specifications.

sources.title: Sound On Sound, Moog DFAM review
sources.note: High-pass mode cuts lows but is not a smooth sweep over the whole range.

sources.title: B&H Photo, Moog DFAM specifications
sources.note: Filter described as a 4-pole transistor ladder; VCOs ±5 octaves.

architecture.patch_memory_note: No memory; the sequencer is analogue (knob per step).
architecture.summary: Two VCOs (10-octave range, triangle or square) with hard sync and VCO 1 -> VCO 2 linear FM; a pitch envelope shared by both VCOs at separate bipolar depths. VCO 1, VCO 2 and noise (or EXT AUDIO) are mixed into a 4-pole ladder filter, low- or high-pass, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, moved by its own envelope and by noise (or the VCF MOD input). The VCA envelope (1 ms or 100 ms attack) shapes the output. Every envelope is a decay with voltage-controlled time, its peak set by the step's VELOCITY. The 8-step sequencer has PITCH (±5 V) and VELOCITY (0-5 V) per step and a voltage-controlled clock VCO (10 to 10,000 BPM).

modules.name: Sequencer clock VCO
modules.description: Clock oscillator, 0.7 Hz to 700 Hz (about 10 to 10,000 BPM at 16ths); 1 V/oct TEMPO input reaches audio rate.

modules.name: 8-step sequencer
modules.description: Analogue 8-step sequencer: PITCH (±5 V, about 10 octaves) and VELOCITY (0-5 V) per step, step LEDs, RUN/STOP, ADVANCE, TRIGGER.

modules.name: Trigger bus
modules.description: Sequencer triggers (normalled to the TRIGGER input) fire all three envelopes and the TRIGGER output (about 1 ms, +5 V).

modules.name: Velocity bus
modules.description: Step velocity (normalled to the VELOCITY input) sets the peak, and slightly lengthens the decay, of all three envelopes.

modules.name: VCO EG
modules.description: Attack 1 ms; decay set by its knob plus a ±5 V CV; peak and decay scaled by velocity. Output 0 to +8 V.

modules.name: VCF EG
modules.description: Attack 1 ms; decay set by its knob plus a ±5 V CV; peak and decay scaled by velocity. Output 0 to +8 V.

modules.name: VCA EG
modules.description: Attack 1 ms or 100 ms (VCA EG switch); decay set by its knob plus a ±5 V CV; peak and decay scaled by velocity. Output 0 to +8 V.

modules.name: VCO 1
modules.description: Analogue VCO, 10-octave range, triangle or square.

modules.name: VCO 2
modules.description: Analogue VCO, 10-octave range, triangle or square. Hard sync to VCO 1 and linear FM from VCO 1.

modules.name: Noise generator
modules.description: White noise; mixer source (unless EXT AUDIO is patched) and the default VCF modulation source.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: VCO 1, noise/external and VCO 2 levels into the filter; high levels clip pleasantly. The noise/ext channel has a CV-controlled level (NOISE LEVEL input).

modules.name: VCF modulation
modules.description: Scales noise (or the VCF MOD input, which replaces it) into the cutoff; the only direct CV path to the cutoff.

modules.name: VCF (ladder)
modules.description: 4-pole (-24 dB/octave) ladder filter, low-pass or high-pass, 20 Hz to 20 kHz; self-oscillates above about 3:00 resonance in LP (in HP only near 1 kHz).

properties.self_oscillates: LP above 3:00 resonance; HP only around 1 kHz

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Output VCA driven by the VCA EG, summed with the VCA CV input.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: VOLUME to the VCA patch output (Eurorack level) and the rear 1/4 inch output (TS line or TRS headphones).

ports.label: TRIGGER
ports.function: Fires all three envelopes at the current step's velocity without advancing; normalled to the sequencer clock. 0-5 V pulse or gate (10 V tolerant).

ports.label: VCA CV
ports.function: Volume CV, 0 to +8 V, summed with the VCA EG (may clip).

ports.label: VCA
ports.function: Main audio output after VOLUME, Eurorack level (±5 V).

ports.label: VELOCITY
ports.function: Envelope peak level, 0-5 V; normalled to the step VELOCITY knobs.

ports.label: VCA DECAY
ports.function: VCA decay CV, ±5 V, summed with the knob (centre it for full range).

ports.label: VCA EG
ports.function: VCA envelope, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: EXT AUDIO
ports.function: External audio replaces noise in the mixer at NOISE/EXT LEVEL; unity gain, expects 10 Vpp (TS cable).

ports.label: VCF DECAY
ports.function: VCF decay CV, ±5 V.

ports.label: VCF EG
ports.function: VCF envelope, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: NOISE LEVEL
ports.function: Adds to NOISE/EXT LEVEL, 0 to +8 V (may clip).

ports.label: VCO DECAY
ports.function: Pitch envelope decay CV, ±5 V.

ports.label: VCO EG
ports.function: Pitch envelope, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: VCF MOD
ports.function: Replaces noise as the VCF modulation source, ±5 V, depth by NOISE/VCF MOD (full CW for full CV control).

ports.label: VCO 1 CV
ports.function: 1 V/oct, ±5 V, summed with knob, EG and sequencer (for clean 1 V/oct: FREQ and EG centred, SEQ PITCH MOD off or VCO 2).

ports.label: VCO 1
ports.function: VCO 1, ±5 V.

ports.label: 1→2 FM AMT
ports.function: Adds to the FM amount, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: VCO 2 CV
ports.function: 1 V/oct, ±5 V, summed with knob, EG and sequencer.

ports.label: VCO 2
ports.function: VCO 2, ±5 V.

ports.label: TEMPO
ports.function: 1 V/oct control of the clock VCO, ±5 V, summed with TEMPO; can reach audio rate.

ports.label: RUN / STOP
ports.function: High runs, low stops the sequencer at its current step (0-5 V, 10 V tolerant).

ports.label: ADV / CLOCK
ports.function: Each rising edge advances one step; TEMPO is then ignored. Slow edges may be missed.

ports.label: TRIGGER
ports.function: About 1 ms +5 V pulse per sequencer step.

ports.label: VELOCITY
ports.function: Current step velocity, 0-5 V.

ports.label: PITCH
ports.function: Current step pitch, ±5 V.

ports.label: AUDIO OUT
ports.function: 1/4 inch: TS instrument cable or TRS headphones (not balanced line).

ports.label: 12VDC
ports.function: 12 V DC 1,200 mA centre-positive adapter; no power switch. Eurorack: 230 mA max from +12 V.

connections.note: ADV/CLOCK replaces the clock VCO; TEMPO is ignored.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: VCO 1, noise/ext and VCO 2 are mixed into the LP/HP ladder filter, then the VCA (VCA EG), then VOLUME.

behaviours.name: Velocity and envelopes
behaviours.rule: Each step's VELOCITY sets the peak of all three decay envelopes (and slightly lengthens their decay), so it shapes loudness, punch and accent; zero velocity is silent.

behaviours.name: Pitch envelope
behaviours.rule: One pitch envelope reaches both VCOs at separate bipolar depths; positive for spikes (kicks), negative for dips. With both depths centred its decay does nothing. Typical decay 9-10:00 for drum punch.

behaviours.name: Sequencer pitch
behaviours.rule: SEQ PITCH MOD sends the PITCH knobs to both VCOs, VCO 2 only, or neither (PITCH output only, e.g. to VCA DECAY for hi-hat variation).

behaviours.name: Oscillator interaction
behaviours.rule: HARD SYNC locks VCO 2 to VCO 1 (VCO 2 below VCO 1 may be near silent, especially square). 1→2 FM is linear, clearest with sync off.

behaviours.name: Noise roles
behaviours.rule: Noise is a sound source (snares, hats, attack) and the default cutoff modulator (dirt, sizzle). EXT AUDIO replaces it in the mixer; VCF MOD replaces it as modulator.

behaviours.name: Filter
behaviours.rule: LP or HP, 20 Hz to 20 kHz; EG amount raises or lowers cutoff in either mode. Self-oscillation above about 3:00 resonance in LP; in HP only near 1 kHz. Sound On Sound finds HP mode is not a smooth sweep across the range.

behaviours.name: VCA attack
behaviours.rule: FAST: 1 ms (as the other envelopes). SLOW: 100 ms, softer attacks and a glide-like effect on bass lines.

behaviours.name: Clock and sync
behaviours.rule: The clock is a VCO (TEMPO CV is 1 V/oct, to audio rate). ADV/CLOCK steps the sequencer per rising edge and overrides TEMPO; RUN/STOP input runs while high. Sync units by TRIGGER OUT into ADV/CLOCK (start the follower first).

behaviours.name: Stopped-sequencer editing
behaviours.rule: With the sequencer stopped, ADVANCE steps without sounding and TRIGGER replays the current step.

behaviours.name: Pitch safety
behaviours.rule: Several pitch sources sum, so VCOs can leave the audible range; recover by centring FREQ, then EG amounts, then SEQ PITCH MOD off.

behaviours.name: Eurorack
behaviours.rule: Removes from its case as a 60HP module (26 mm deep), 230 mA from +12 V, no -12 V.

midi.note: None. Sync by ADV/CLOCK, TRIGGER and RUN/STOP; a Mother-32's assignable output can clock it.

specifications.filter: selectable HP/LP 4-pole (-24 dB/oct) ladder, 20 Hz to 20 kHz
specifications.envelopes: VCO EG, VCF EG (10 ms to 10 s), VCA EG (1 ms or 100 ms attack), all with voltage-controlled decay
specifications.rear: 1/4 inch TRS headphone or TS instrument; 12 VDC

power.adapter: 100-240 V AC, +12 V DC 1,200 mA, centre positive

omitted_from_source: knob settings drawn on the ten preset patch sheets (cables are transcribed)
not_in_source: VCO and VCA decay ranges (only the VCF's 10 ms to 10 s is given; not found in research)
the RUN/STOP input's behaviour with a clock beyond the note given
source_inconsistencies: The RUN/STOP input note says an external clock there advances steps 'in the same way repeatedly pressing the RUN/STOP button does', while RUN/STOP is described as start/stop, not step (p.29).
Velocity is said to set the envelopes' amplitude (p.22) and also their decay time (pp.15, 19, 21).
The signal flow diagram labels VCO 2's knob 'VC0 2 FREQ' (letter O for zero) (p.7).
Sequenced Bass's notes imply sequenced pitch on both VCOs but the switch position is only drawn; recorded as inferred (p.34).

modelling_gaps.detail: Velocity's effect on decay time is described qualitatively; modelled only as the velocity input to each envelope.
